attendance_policy: Attendance in all lectures and tutorials is recommended for continuous reinforced learning. A record of attendance will be kept without any prejudice as per the institute's policy. Long absences in the tutorial/lecture classes will result in a warning through email, and further, it may be reported to AUGSD/SWD for a student welfare check.
makeup_policy: If a student cannot appear for the Comprehensive and/or Midsemester Examination due to genuine exigencies, the student must refer to the procedure prescribed by AUGSD for applying for the Make-up Test/Examination. All makeup applications should come through AUGSD portal only. If possible, it is recommended to discuss with IC prior to the absence. No make-up will be granted for the tutorials/surprise quizzes/discussion/projects/assignments.
